title: Employee, IB Operations - Trade & Processing Specialist

titleByLocale.en: Employee, IB Operations - Trade & Processing Specialist
titleByLocale.de: Employee, IB Operations - Trade & Processing Spezialist
titleByLocale.fr: Employee, IB Operations - Trade & Processing Spécialiste

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Employee, IB Operations - Trade & Processing Specialist in Nashville, TN. Are you an innovative thinker? Are you focused on the details, even when under pressure? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? We’re looking for an Employee, IB Operations - Trade & Processing Specialist to:
• Uphold compliance with legal, regulatory, and statutory obligations, as well as internal policies and contracts including Vendor Risk Framework and GCOO Operational Risk Framework. Assist the Mortgage Finance operations team in handling the daily requests for loan funding and repayments from clients, specifically mortgage lenders with a line of credit with the bank.
• Validate trade particulars and ensure their accuracy before finalizing transactions with counterparties. Detect and resolve disparities between internal records and external sources, investigate failed trades, and reconcile unmatched transactions.
• Address issues, introduce new initiatives, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives. Support the complete lifecycle of securitization trades, from execution through settlement.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote). Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 002091. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V. #LI-DNI Salary & Work Schedule: $56,070 Per Year, 40 hrs/wk. The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.
